findings.detail: Criticality: 6/10. The filter tests change raw bytes while normalized content holds, but none keeps raw_tree unchanged while filter output changes tree. Replacing the new raw comparison's append with an overwrite would pass these tests while discarding normalized-only paths and returning changed: [] for a changed clean-filter output. Existing missing-normalized-object coverage checks failure handling, not this union behavior.
findings.fix: Add captures that change only a fixture-local clean filter command, leaving file bytes unchanged. Assert equal raw_tree, different tree and snapshot, and the exact changed and outside_scope paths from codex-aspects changes.
findings.title: write-scrut-tests: Behavioral coverage omits normalized-only change reporting.

strengths: Tests distinguish staged-content changes from disk and membership changes.
Sparse and metadata cases cover availability, exact symlink text, both type transitions and owner-execute changes.
Recursive and marked mutation fixtures exercise nested reporting and inconsistent-capture refusal.
Legacy and mixed-format captures assert meaningful changed paths.
summary: Reviewed the complete fixed-base membership and mapped changed behavior to added and existing tests. Coverage is broad, with one suggested regression test for the normalized/raw comparison union. No tests, builds or writes were performed.
